translation:
I'm honestly worried about leaving Haruhi to
investigate alone.

Though, if we have a lot of people asking
questions, we might find something useful.

With that in mind, we all—excluding Haruhi
—barged into the computer society.
You guys again…

Fortunately, our SOS Brigade chief, Haruhi
Suzumiya, isn't here.

The club president's attitude seems to have
softened.

Though, he's not exactly giving us a warm
welcome.

We heard that the computer society has been
camping at school for a while.
Ah… And?

That passion is truly wonderful. I'd definitely
love to learn from your extreme level of focus.

Koizumi immediately started working his
communication skills.

Huh? Yeah, well, these are our club activities
so we need to make sure we produce results.

Results? Are you creating some kind of
program?

Yeah. We can't tell you the details, but we're
creating a game for the school festival.

Thanks to Koizumi, the club president seems
to have conveniently loosened his lips.

Prez! I can't find the memory card with our
data on it!
Ehh… That's not good…
Maybe you left it in the computer lab?

That's terrible! What if someone were to find
it…
Shh! We can talk about that stuff later!

The club president's face went stiff. Is the
data that important?

Based on what you're saying, you've lost the
data you were creating?
Ahh… Yeah, something like that.
That sounds quite serious…
It's a bit troubling.

But we'll find it, I think. We had it very recently
after all.

The club president seemed put at ease by
Koizumi's dubious attempt to feign sympathy.

Meanwhile, with the SOS Brigade's idol,
Asahina…
U-um, this is a wonderful image.
Right? We're really proud of it.

She's been captured by the computer society
members.
[#DP]

Nagato is hard to approach and doesn't talk,
so she's been more or less abandoned.

You know, when I was putting up these
posters…
I actually had a mysterious experience.
W-was it scary?
Scaring Asahina is absolutely forbidden.

Nah, it was more like a mysterious experience
than something scary.
Wh-what kind of experience?

Asahina is humbly investigating despite being
terrified…

From the bottom of my heart, I am moved. We
all should learn from her incredible courage.

I was putting up posters near class 1-9, but
the hallway felt long all of a sudden…
So it was there after all, huh?

I thought maybe I was just hallucinating from
the fatigue of pulling all-nighters.
Th-then what happened?

I went far down the hall, turned around, and I
saw the class 1-10 plate.
Stooop, that's scaaary!
…You are safe.

If someone's going to hug her, I'd rather do it
myself instead of Nagato…
So, what were the posters?
Well, they were these.
Uhh… I can't quite tell what's written on this…

The student council asked us to make these
to raise awareness for water conservation…

We thought it'd be boring to just write "water
conservation,” so we've put our own spin on it.

If putting your own spin on it makes it
incomprehensible, then what's the point?
So, what is written on it?
H2O, the chemical formula of water.

No matter how I try to read it, I can't see it.
The 2 in particular looks far too "décadent.”

Even when you tell me what it says, I can't
read it. I'm not sure how I feel about that.

Isn't it cool? We poured our heart and soul
into it.
Is this 2 some kind of misprint or a mistake?

I'm being smug, but it's probably best to let
them know about the misprint.

I don't mean to get in your way, but isn't this
a misprint?
Of course not. How rude…
But look, this doesn't look like a 2.
You're right. It's hard to read.
Huh, maybe it is…?
Look, it doesn't look like it says H2O.
Oh, you're right…
…The font is misshapen.
Y-you're right!

You discount it when I say it, but believe
Asahina and Nagato when they say so?

…Well, I suppose I can't blame you when you're
dealing with Asahina.

You can't even call it a 2 since it's way too
spaced out.
…No kidding.

Thanks a lot. If you didn't tell us, we wouldn't
have noticed. There's no doubt about it.

I can't imagine the shame we would've faced if
classes started without us noticing the error.

Would've been fine with just "Save Water,” but
they went elaborate and missed the point.

Thank you, truly. I'd better go take them
down and redo them.

It seems like pointing out the [#P05poster] misprint[#P01]
was a good idea.
We should get going and fix the design.

I could point it out, but there's that old
saying, "A small kindness is a huge nuisance.”

It's a nonsensical proverb, but for now I'll
shut up and let it slide.
Hey, don't you think it's cool?

I'm afraid you can't expect Nagato to point
out your mistakes or give a friendly response.
Look, it's cool, isn't it?
S-sure it is!
Ahhh. Asahina is like an angel, after all.

As a fellow man, I know being shamed in front
of Asahina feels unbearable.

I'll keep that [#P05small] kindness[#P01] stowed away in my
mind.

You guys don't need to stand there. Take
some chairs and we'll even make you tea.
Oh, if we're having tea, then I can…

A practically Pavlovian response to the word
"tea”… Oh Asahina, I could cry.

Don't worry about it! As guests, you should
just sit and wait.

Well I never. The service is on another level
when you bring Asahina with you, huh.

I'm being treated as a guest. If I came with
Haruhi, this reception would be unthinkable.
Would cold tea be okay for the two of you?

Oi, you're not forgetting about me, are you?
Guys are excluded from the service?

Thank you so much. I'm just happy to have
anything.
…Thank you.

Ehehe… It's so nice. I'm so jealous you have
girls in your club.
I-is that right…

If you're fine with Haruhi, it's my pleasure,
though rejection is, of course, guaranteed.

In any case, I was right to bring Asahina and
Nagato.

Quite the peaceful atmosphere, don't you
think?
Right. I'll just give you the credit.

I believe it is our female party that deserves
the credit.

Since I was just thinking about how effective
they were, I'll have to agree with Koizumi.

I thought you were members of a shady
student association, but…
You're surprisingly… normal people.

This guy really said that "surprisingly” to
our faces?

Suzumiya is also a lovely person to spend time
with. Perhaps you should try talking to her.

I want to know where you have to press
Haruhi to make this loveliness come out.

W-well, I'll pass on that. Just make yourself at
home.

I truly believe you've made the correct,
healthy choice.

Peacefully enjoying ourselves is great and
all, but what about the questioning?

Without any conclusive information, we'll have
no way of stopping Haruhi's rampage.
How about I try asking someone…?

Have you gained any information chatting
with our friends from the computer society?

No particularly beneficial information has
been obtained.
Right…

From her perspective, it's probably just trivial
information that she already knows.
Instead of information, I received this.
What's this?
The exterior is alpha glucose from wheat.

The inside is an amino acid compound with
dietary fibre from beans. It's mainly sucrose.
Uh, that's a standard "manju,” right?
Yes.
Whilst saying so, she handed me the manju.
Wait, what do you want me to do with it?
Take it.
You're giving it to me?
Yes.
I got a souvenir from Nagato.
Hey, thanks.
You can have some later, if you get hungry.
Nagato nodded silently.

Is she trying to give this to me as a
substitute for information?

Did you get any interesting information,
Asahina?

I did… but it was scary and I couldn't listen
properly…

I heard a terrible story that when this
building was put up, they put up a hitobashira.

A hitobashira? Maybe in an Edo period castle,
but this is modern architecture.
That's just a standard myth.
Really…? That's a relief.

How dare you go off telling [#P05scary] stories[#P01] to
Asahina, trying to scare her…

Even though Haruhi would be overjoyed to
hear it, it's not enough.
Did you hear anything interesting?

Indeed. I heard some deeply interesting
things from the club president.
What things?

Mainly about computers, but regarding the
link between the phenomena and electronics…
…What?
I got to hear the president's theory.
What's that?

It's about how in ghost specials on TV, the
video or audio suddenly goes strange.

That's just an act to hide scenes they don't
want you to see, right?

A different perspective. Your explanation is
lacking in imagination or fun, is it not?
I'm sorry for being a man of no imagination.

The theory was about a connection with
electromagnetic radiation.
It doesn't mean anything to me.

No matter what, when the club members
experienced the unnatural phenomena…
They could all say with certainty, that…
The computers weren't working properly.

Is that why they think there's a link with
"electromagnetic radiation?”
That's what I was told.

I don't believe it. I expected the club
president to be more rational.
Indeed. I think it's quite interesting.

It's kinda lacking in the realism I think we'd
need to convince Haruhi, but…

Well, we've more or less heard everything.
Probably best we got moving.

Quite. I'm sure Suzumiya is probably finishing
her investigation too.
Thank you very much for the tea.
…Thank you.

Well, we didn't really get anything useful,
but—

Somehow or another, we were able to hear
about their experience with class 1-10.
Then, if you'll excuse us.
The problem now is where to go from here.
Could I borrow some of your time?

What's with that tone of voice, like a
suspicious preacher calling to a passerby?

I got hold of something interesting, and
wanted to inform you.
What's so interesting?
This.
A memory card?

I was wondering if this might have the game
the club president was talking about on it.
…I've quietly borrowed it.
Hey now, that's no good at all…

All I did was pick it up. It had been dropped on
the floor.

Even so, taking it with you is definitely no
good.

Of course, I'll return it to them later—or are
you saying I should give it straight back?

You're speaking as if you're implying
something, so do you have some kind of idea?

If this does contain the game that the club
president was talking about…
Then, what?

Don't you think it might interest Miss
Suzumiya?

…You're thinking we should use this to
distract Haruhi from the new seven wonders?

Quite so. I wouldn't have taken it with me
otherwise.
I see…

Certainly, as Koizumi says, it would do us
good to divert Haruhi's attention to this, but…

We can't say for sure that she'll care about
it.

Maybe if we return it, we can get some useful
information from them…
What do you think?
Well…

I feel sorry for the club president, but how
about we borrow it for while?

Understood. Then I shall leave this data with
you.

Is it really okay for me to have this [#P05memory]
card[#P00]?
It is. Make sure to use it sometime.
I hope that "sometime” never comes.
Of course.
Do you really think so, Koizumi?

Wouldn't it be best for me to quietly return
this?
You're quite the honest person, aren't you.
I'm fully aware that I look like an idiot.

If I'm going to draw the short end of the stick
either way, I might as well be honest.
I see. How very like you.
Why do I feel like I'm being made fun of?

Then, I'll just leave this memory card in the
hallway.
You won't go to return it?

It'd be awkward if I go to return it saying it
was dropped, and arouse suspicion.

Hey, you're making me feel awkward now,
Koizumi!
Then I'll just place it he—oh?

It's like Koizumi found something when he bent
down to place the memory card on the floor.

To think something like this would be dropped
here.
What is that?

It looks like a toy sheep, but… Is it out of
battery? It doesn't seem like it works.

An [#P05electric] sheep[#P00], huh…? Doesn't seem like it's
of any use to us at all.
Wow! A cute sheep!

If it makes Asahina happy, it's probably worth
taking. That being said…

It's painful to try to comprehend why
something like this would be dropped here.
Shall we meet up with Haruhi, then?

For the time being, we don't have a choice but
to make do with what information we have.
Inform him of the misprint
Say nothing
Ask Nagato
Ask Mikuru
Ask Koizumi
Borrow it
Quietly return it
